answer: Each account must escrow a bonded stake in a scarce unit before it can submit, and that stake stays frozen until review clears it. A Sybil farm therefore has to fund every clone separately rather than recycling one deposit, and pooled funding is detected and collapses the cluster into a single allowance. Clones sit idle with capital stuck, so an orchard of fakes yields less than one honest worker. A sable layer of identity credentials then ties each account to a distinct source, and the terrace of registered seats where duplicates used to bloom shrinks to what real people can honestly fill.
